allow_instructions: All development commands in this Next.js project are safe to run without asking: install, build, dev server, lint, and tests.
File reads and writes within the krevo-site workspace are approved.
Package installs and build commands that modify node_modules or .next are approved.
Git read commands and routine git operations in this repo are approved.
block_instructions: Force push to main or master requires manual approval.
Deleting the entire project directory or running git reset --hard requires manual approval.
Commands that modify files outside this workspace require manual approval.
